sources.title: ClinicalCamel-70B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview ClinicalCamel-70B is a medical large language model built on the LLaMA-2 70B architecture and fine-tuned using QLoRA for clinical and medical research applications. Created by wanglab, the model processes and generates medical content with competitive performance on clinical benchmarks.
